combo1.title: Atlantis: Warchief + Siren Vortex into Neo-Daedalus Rage
combo1.description: Going first with two Beyond the Brave cards. Warchief of Atlantis finds Advent of Atlantis, Advent places Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon, and Warchief comes back because Advent is named "Umi" on the field. Siren Vortex of Atlantis and Advent's Graveyard search bring out Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus. With Atlantis in the Field Zone, Levia-Dragoon - Daedalus needs only 2 materials and Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage only 3. Rage then brings Levia-Dragoon back from the Graveyard, so both of their Quick Effects are ready for your opponent's turn. Starting hand: Warchief of Atlantis + Siren Vortex of Atlantis.

cards.name: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon
Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage

steps.text: Activate effect: Warchief of Atlantis in your hand. The cost is discarding Warchief itself.
Discard Warchief of Atlantis to the GY as the cost.
The effect resolves: add Advent of Atlantis from your Deck to your hand. Warchief adds any Spell/Trap that mentions Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon.
Activate Advent of Atlantis (Continuous Spell). While it's face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone, its name is "Umi".
Activate effect: Advent of Atlantis. In your Main Phase it places 1 Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon or 1 "Umi" from your Deck face-up in your Field Zone.
Place Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon face-up in your Field Zone. The card is placed, not activated.
Activate effect: Warchief of Atlantis in the GY. You control "Umi" (Advent of Atlantis), so Warchief can bring itself back.
Special Summon Warchief of Atlantis from your GY. It mentions Atlantis, so while it's on the field Atlantis lowers the Level of every monster in both hands and on both fields by 1.
Normal Summon Siren Vortex of Atlantis.
Activate effect: Siren Vortex of Atlantis (when it's summoned). It sends 1 card that mentions Atlantis from your Deck to the GY.
Send the second Advent of Atlantis from your Deck to the GY.

Activate effect: Advent of Atlantis in the GY. It was sent there, so it adds 1 Level 7 Sea Serpent monster from your Deck. This is a different effect from the one the first Advent used, so both work this turn.
Add Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus to your hand.
Special Summon Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus from your hand with its own effect: you control Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon.
Activate effect: Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus. The cost is sending up to 3 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY, and it adds that many cards. Send just 1.
Send Siren Vortex of Atlantis to the GY as the cost. On the field its name is "Umi".
The effect resolves: add Monster Arms of Atlantis from your Deck to your hand. Its last part, sending 1 card on the field to the GY, is optional; going first there's nothing to hit.
Activate effect: Siren Vortex of Atlantis in the GY. It was sent there while you control "Umi" (Levia-Dragon and Advent), so it brings out 1 WATER monster from your hand.
Special Summon Monster Arms of Atlantis from your hand.
Activate effect: Monster Arms of Atlantis (when it's summoned). Target Siren Vortex of Atlantis in your GY; it mentions Atlantis.
Special Summon Siren Vortex of Atlantis from your GY in Defense Position. Its own summon effect was already used this turn.
Siren Vortex of Atlantis becomes material for Levia-Dragoon - Daedalus. With Atlantis in your Field Zone, this Link-3 needs only 2 WATER monsters.
Warchief of Atlantis becomes the second material.
Link Summon Levia-Dragoon - Daedalus to the Extra Monster Zone.
Activate effect: Levia-Dragoon - Daedalus (when it's summoned from the Extra Deck). It brings out 1 monster that mentions Atlantis from your Deck.
Special Summon the second Warchief of Atlantis from your Deck.
Levia-Dragoon - Daedalus becomes material for Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage. With Atlantis in your Field Zone, this Link-4 needs only 3 monsters, and Levia-Dragoon counts as 1 of them.
Monster Arms of Atlantis becomes the second material.
The second Warchief of Atlantis becomes the third material. Levia-Dragon of Atlantis stays on the field.

Link Summon Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage to the Extra Monster Zone. From there its bottom-left, bottom and bottom-right arrows point at your first three Main Monster Zones, which are now empty.

Activate effect: Neo-Daedalus Rage (when it's summoned from the Extra Deck). Up to 3 monsters that mention Atlantis return from your GY to the zones it points to. After this you can't bring out any more monsters this turn.
Special Summon Levia-Dragoon - Daedalus from your GY. It was properly summoned before, so it can come back. It mentions Atlantis in its own text.
Special Summon Monster Arms of Atlantis from your GY. Its summon effect was already used this turn.
Special Summon Warchief of Atlantis from your GY.

End of the line: Neo-Daedalus Rage (2900), Levia-Dragoon (2600), Levia-Dragon of Atlantis (2600), Monster Arms and Warchief, with Advent of Atlantis and Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon behind them. On your opponent's turn: Rage sends 1 "Umi" to the GY to send every card on the field that isn't "Umi" to the GY (a Quick Effect, once per turn). Levia-Dragoon sends 1 "Umi" in the Main Phase to discard their whole hand and make them draw that many, and nobody can respond. Monster Arms banishes itself and sends 1 "Umi" to negate a monster effect. Every card left on your field except Atlantis is named "Umi", so Rage's sweep leaves your board standing.

combo2.title: Classic Meets Atlantis: Advent + Kairyu-Shin Lock With a Spare "Umi"
combo2.description: Two cards that join the old lock to the new engine. Advent of Atlantis can place A Legendary Ocean, because A Legendary Ocean is always treated as "Umi", even in the Deck. That lets Ocean Dragon Lord - Kairyu-Shin be Normal Summoned without a Tribute, and Advent is a second "Umi" that keeps Kairyu-Shin's lock on if the Field Spell is removed. Kairyu-Shin adds Kairyu-Shin's Dark Reef. On your opponent's turn, Dark Reef sends Advent to the GY, which adds a Level 7 Sea Serpent, and brings Electric Jellyfish and Fisherman of Legend out of the Deck. Starting hand: Advent of Atlantis + Ocean Dragon Lord - Kairyu-Shin.

steps.text: Activate Advent of Atlantis (Continuous Spell). While it's face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone, its name is "Umi".

Activate effect: Advent of Atlantis. It places 1 Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon or 1 "Umi" from your Deck face-up in your Field Zone. A Legendary Ocean is always treated as "Umi", even in the Deck, so it qualifies.
Place A Legendary Ocean face-up in your Field Zone. WATER monsters in both hands and on both fields are now 1 Level lower and gain 200 ATK/DEF on the field.

Normal Summon Ocean Dragon Lord - Kairyu-Shin without a Tribute: A Legendary Ocean makes it Level 4 in your hand. Atlantis would only do that once a monster that mentions Atlantis is already on the field.
Activate effect: Ocean Dragon Lord - Kairyu-Shin. It adds 1 "Umi", 1 "Kairyu-Shin" Spell/Trap or 1 "Sea Stealth" Spell/Trap from your Deck.
Add Kairyu-Shin's Dark Reef to your hand.

Set Kairyu-Shin's Dark Reef and end your turn. The lock is on: with "Umi" on the field, each player can control only 1 face-up non-WATER monster. A Legendary Ocean and Advent are both "Umi", so removing the Field Spell alone doesn't switch the lock off.
Your opponent's turn. Once they have a monster on the field, flip and activate Kairyu-Shin's Dark Reef.
Send Advent of Atlantis to the GY as the cost: it's a face-up "Umi" you control. A Legendary Ocean stays, so the lock stays on.
Dark Reef resolves. Special Summon Electric Jellyfish from your Deck in Defense Position; it mentions "Umi".
Special Summon Fisherman of Legend from your Deck in Defense Position; it mentions "Umi" too and has a different name. Until the end of your next turn you can only Special Summon WATER monsters.
Kairyu-Shin's Dark Reef goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Fisherman of Legend (when it's summoned). Target 1 monster your opponent controls and destroy it. In the End Phase, Fisherman goes back to your hand.
Activate effect: Advent of Atlantis in the GY, chained with Fisherman. It was sent there as Dark Reef's cost, so it adds 1 Level 7 Sea Serpent monster from your Deck.
Add Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus to your hand. Next turn it can bring itself out, because you control "Umi".

End Phase: Fisherman of Legend returns to your hand. From there it's a hand trap: when your opponent activates a monster effect on the field or attacks while "Umi" is on the field, it comes out of your hand and destroys a monster again.

End of the line: Kairyu-Shin keeps the lock on, Electric Jellyfish can negate a monster effect or a Spell while "Umi" is on the field, Fisherman of Legend waits in your hand, and Levia-Dragon of Atlantis is ready for your turn. Your next Advent can place Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon; the new Field Spell sends A Legendary Ocean to the GY, and the Atlantis monsters keep "Umi" on the field.

combo3.title: Going Second: Call of Atlantis + Siren Vortex, Rage Sweep for 8500
combo3.description: Going second into a full board. Call of Atlantis adds Monster Arms of Atlantis, Siren Vortex sends Advent of Atlantis to the GY for Levia-Dragon of Atlantis, and Levia-Dragon's search sends one of your opponent's cards to the GY without targeting it. A second Advent places Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon, so Neo-Daedalus Rage needs only 3 materials. Rage brings 3 monsters back, then its Quick Effect sends every card on the field that isn't "Umi" to the GY. Nothing is destroyed and nothing is targeted. Atlantis returns from the GY, Call of Atlantis gives +500 ATK, and three attacks deal 8500. Starting hand: Call of Atlantis + Siren Vortex of Atlantis.

cards.name: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon
Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage

steps.text: Activate Call of Atlantis (Normal Spell).
It resolves: add Monster Arms of Atlantis from your Deck to your hand. You don't control Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon yet, so its negate half doesn't apply.
Call of Atlantis goes to the GY. Its second effect works from there later.
Normal Summon Siren Vortex of Atlantis.
Activate effect: Siren Vortex of Atlantis (when it's summoned). It sends 1 card that mentions Atlantis from your Deck to the GY.
Send Advent of Atlantis from your Deck to the GY.
Activate effect: Advent of Atlantis in the GY. It was sent there, so it adds 1 Level 7 Sea Serpent monster from your Deck.
Add Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus to your hand.
Special Summon Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus from your hand with its own effect: you control "Umi", because Siren Vortex's name on the field is "Umi".
Activate effect: Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus. The cost is sending up to 3 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY. Send just 1.
Send Siren Vortex of Atlantis to the GY as the cost.
The effect resolves: add the second Advent of Atlantis from your Deck to your hand.
Then send 1 card on the field to the GY. Pick the card most likely to stop the rest of this line, such as a face-up floodgate or a Set Trap. This part doesn't target and doesn't destroy.
Activate effect: Siren Vortex of Atlantis in the GY. It was sent there while you control "Umi" (Levia-Dragon), so it brings out 1 WATER monster from your hand.
Special Summon Monster Arms of Atlantis from your hand.
Activate effect: Monster Arms of Atlantis (when it's summoned). Target Siren Vortex of Atlantis in your GY.
Special Summon Siren Vortex of Atlantis from your GY in Defense Position.
Activate the second Advent of Atlantis (Continuous Spell). Its name is "Umi" while face-up.
Activate effect: Advent of Atlantis. It places Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon from your Deck face-up in your Field Zone.
Place Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon face-up in your Field Zone.
Siren Vortex of Atlantis becomes material for Neo-Daedalus Rage. With Atlantis in your Field Zone, the Link-4 needs only 3 monsters. Siren's GY effect was already used this turn.
Monster Arms of Atlantis becomes the second material.
Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus becomes the third material.
Link Summon Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage to the Extra Monster Zone. Its bottom-left, bottom and bottom-right arrows point at your first three Main Monster Zones.

Activate effect: Neo-Daedalus Rage (when it's summoned from the Extra Deck). Up to 3 monsters that mention Atlantis return from your GY to the zones it points to. After this you can't bring out any more monsters this turn.
Special Summon Siren Vortex of Atlantis from your GY.
Special Summon Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus from your GY in Attack Position.
Special Summon Monster Arms of Atlantis from your GY in Attack Position.
Activate effect: Neo-Daedalus Rage (Quick Effect, once per turn). The cost is sending 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY.
Send Siren Vortex of Atlantis to the GY as the cost.

It resolves: every card on the field that isn't named "Umi" goes to the GY. That's your opponent's whole field, face-down cards included, with no targeting and no destruction. Your own Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon isn't "Umi", so it goes too. Rage, Levia-Dragon, Monster Arms and Advent all stay.
Activate effect: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon in the GY. You control "Umi", so it can place itself face-up again, once per turn.
Place Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon face-up in your Field Zone.
Activate effect: Call of Atlantis in the GY. You control "Umi", so banish it: WATER monsters you control gain 500 ATK/DEF.
Banish Call of Atlantis from your GY as the cost.

Battle Phase: Neo-Daedalus Rage (3400), Levia-Dragon of Atlantis (3100) and Monster Arms (2000) attack directly for 8500 damage. Watch for Infinite Impermanence or Effect Veiler on Rage before its sweep resolves, and Ash Blossom on Siren's Deck send or Advent's search.
